root_cause.summary: loop_health and loop_health_detail queried LoopControllerStore with the authorized trading stage (paper) while every LoopControllerWriter records environment as the deployment environment (PANTHEON_ENV, dev on the dev VM), so /bff/v5/loop-health never returned a controller record for any of the twelve loops.
root_cause.introduced_by: #6287 BFF-LOOP-TRUTH-STAGE-SCOPE-20261007 (merged 2026-10-07T12:45Z): its shared authenticated_loop_truth_scope made loop_health use the stage; before it loop_health defaulted to the deployment name.
root_cause.why_unnoticed: MockLoopTruth in tests/test_control_loops_router.py asserted environment == 'paper', encoding the regression; the store-backed contract tests in test_loop_health_read_model_contract.py and test_current_twelve_owner_truth.py write records with environment dev and have been failing on dev since #6287.
root_cause.detected_by: Isolated runtime suite on a local merge of #6337 and #6339 (2026-10-08): L8-L11 evidence and the downstream-health wait passed, then the suite timed out waiting for the bff_health_monitoring loop-health row to reflect the stopped reconciler.

change: Authorization stays on authenticated_loop_truth_scope (trading stage). loop_health and loop_health_detail query the controller store with the service's deployment environment, and meta.scope adds controller_environment next to the authorized stage. No controller writer changed.
test_changes: New test_loop_health_reads_controller_records_on_the_deployment_environment (committed first; base 9c5d3fe3e: 1 failed, 14 passed in tests/test_control_loops_router.py).
MockLoopTruth now asserts environment == 'dev' (the deployment environment) instead of 'paper', which encoded the regression.

Three exact meta.scope assertions (tests/test_control_loops_router.py and two in test_loop_health_read_model_contract.py) now state the post-#6287 contract: environment is the authorized stage and controller_environment is the deployment environment.
